cag.interpretation: Arithmetic combination of probabilities is not generally normalized log-density guidance. This is not a test of the released CAG action/logit branches and does not refute empirical results.

uln.interpretation: Cross-state raw-logit comparison is sensitive to additive state-dependent offsets, even when within-state action probabilities are unchanged. No claim that trained ULN logits exhibit this failure frequency.
